Formula For each point p the scan visits every edge row e in ascending order and keeps the edge with the smallest point-to-segment distance d(p,e): bestEdge = e when bestEdge is NONE or d < bestDistance (strict, so ties go to the smallest edge row; NaN never wins). Distances are in the spatial context length unit (meters for a great-circle longitude/latitude context); with a maximum snap distance, edges beyond it are skipped and an unsnapped point gets NONE.
